items.author: Tony East
items.body_excerpt:
Currently halftime of both games.

Aces up 65-36 on Mercury

Sparks up 35-26 on Valkyries

If both hold, it would be Fever-Valkyries in the first round.

quote.author: Tony East
quote.text:
Fever first-round opponent:

-If Valkyries beat Sparks: Aces

-If Mercury beat Aces: Aces

-If Aces beat Mercury AND Sparks beat Valkyries: Valkyries
